stance_basis: listed as having responded to draft EIS but no substantive comment content provided in window
summary: The Department of Health, Education, and Welfare is listed among the federal agencies requested to review the draft EIS and is marked with an asterisk indicating it responded. However, no substantive comment content from HEW appears in this window, suggesting their response was either a no-comment notification or is reproduced only in Appendix A, which is outside this window.
complaint_summary: HEW is listed among federal agencies that responded to the draft EIS, indicated by an asterisk in the summary sheet's list of agencies requested to review the draft environmental impact statement.
summary_quote: On January 30, 1976, Staff contacted Ms. Phyllis Hayes, HEW, who indicated that this agency had no comments to make on the Bad Creek DEIS.
